final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink IREF (1 uA)
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=2
* tail current source (2 uA)
M5 tail ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=2 m=2
* input differential pair (vinp = non-inverting)
M1 n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=2 L=1
M2 n2 vinp tail vss nfet W=2 L=1
* PMOS mirror load
M3 n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=1
M4 n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink (6 uA)
M6 vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W=24 L=1
M7 vout ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=2 m=6
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz n2 nz 20k
Cc nz vout 2.5p
.ends
